clips.title: The story
paras: Targorr the Dread is an infamous Blackrock orc executioner imprisoned deep within the Stormwind Stockade. Known for his brutal tortures of captured Stormwind soldiers, his execution was indefinitely delayed by bureaucratic incompetence and corruption. When the Stockade erupted into revolt under the Defias Brotherhood, Targorr broke free and allied with the rioting convicts.

Before his capture, Targorr the Dread served as the supreme executioner for the Blackrock clan under Warlord Gath'Ilzogg. Operating out of the occupied ruins in Redridge, his cruelty stood out as exceptionally savage even by the violent standards of the Dark Horde. Stormwind guards and militiamen who fought to defend the borderlands were subjected to agonizing torment and slow death at his hands, making his name one of the most reviled in the kingdom.

When Alliance forces finally managed to capture Targorr alive, he was brought in chains to the capital and locked inside the high-security Stockade to await execution. However, the rot within Stormwind's judicial and political bureaucracy stalled the proceedings. Paralyzed by graft, endless paperwork, and neglect, the courts failed to deliver the death sentence he had earned, leaving a bloodthirsty war criminal sitting in a cell beneath the heart of the city.

When the Defias Brotherhood staged their violent prison break, Targorr saw his opportunity. Breaking free from his cell, the ruthless orc threw his lot in with the Defias rioters, turning his cellblock into a slaughterhouse. With the prison entirely out of Warden Thelwater's control, towns like Lakeshire—still nursing the bitter wounds Targorr inflicted on their defenders—seek adventurers willing to venture into the riots and bring back the butcher's head.
